description.p: Hungry Snake is a classic snake game for Linux with a bright, cartoon arcade look. Guide a cute snake around a wooden board, eat apples, grow longer and don't bite your own tail or hit a wall. It is the retro worm game you remember, rebuilt with smooth movement, jungle scenery and plenty to unlock. Free, open source and ad-free.
Gameplay:

ul.li: Smooth snake movement that glides between cells, with buffered turns so quick key presses are never lost
A run starts only when you steer, and the speed climbs gently and announces each step, so even a long snake stays in control
Bonus food: a golden star for extra points and a mint leaf that trims your tail when you are boxed in
A cute, expressive snake that blinks, flicks its tongue and watches the apple

description.p: Unlock and customize:

ul.li: Earn Coins just by playing and spend them in the Store on snake skins, board themes, apple styles and bonus food looks
Six animated background scenes: jungle, sunset, twilight, ember, snowfall and aurora
Scene-matched snakes, boards and apples that combine into one coordinated look
Every standard cosmetic unlocks by playing; an optional Supporter Pack adds a few exclusive extras

description.p: Challenges and leaderboard:

ul.li: A new Daily Challenge every day with a streak to keep alive
Achievements that pay out Coins for lifetime and single-run milestones
An opt-in online leaderboard: pick a nickname, post your high score and see your global rank

description.p: Made for the desktop:

ul.li: Play with the arrow keys or WASD, use the mouse in menus, and toggle fullscreen with F11
Six relaxing music tracks, crunchy sound effects and a performance mode for older PCs and laptops
Offline gameplay with no account needed; the leaderboard is the only online part

description.p: A modern take on Snake, Nibbles and other worm games for anyone who likes casual, retro and offline arcade games. Works on Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, Arch, openSUSE and other Linux distributions, on Wayland and X11.

description.p: A refreshed store listing with a clearer description and the screenshots now hosted with the source code.
Hungry Snake is now open source under the GNU GPL, version 3 or later.
Adds fullscreen, a performance mode for low-end machines and a quit confirmation, and Home now shows your global rank with a shortcut to the leaderboard.
Music playback is smoother: tracks are preloaded and pause when the game is in the background.
A big look-and-feel update.
New Supporter Pack unlocks a set of exclusive cosmetics, including the animated Aurora scene, the Golden snake and the Obsidian board.

Adds coordinated, scene-matched snakes, boards and apples so you can build a single cohesive look, plus hand-curated per-scene scenery: a realistic moon, drifting embers and mountain ranges instead of the same forest leaves everywhere.
The Game Over card is clearer (Play Again and Home), the speed ramp now climbs gently and announces each step, and there is an optional key-press sound.
Compete with everyone.
Adds an opt-in global leaderboard: pick a nickname, post your best run and see your rank straight after a high score.
The Pause and Settings menus are now separate, and the difficulty ramp is smoother and easier to read.
Restyle the whole board.
New background Scenes (Sunset, Twilight, Ember and Snowfall), each with its own animated atmosphere drifting behind the play field.
The Store has been reorganised by price and given a readability and contrast pass throughout.
Reasons to come back every day.
Adds a fresh Daily Challenge with a streak to keep alive, and Achievements that pay out Coins as you hit lifetime and single-run milestones.
Six looping soundtracks join the crunchy eat and crash effects, all toggleable.
More ways to dress up your run.
Adds apple styles and bonus-food skins to the Store, and polishes text legibility across the game.
Earn and spend.
You now collect Coins just by playing and can spend them in a new cosmetics Store on snake skins and board themes. Sound effects can be toggled on or off.
First public release of Hungry Snake.
Guide a glossy cartoon snake around a wooden board, gobble apples and grow, with a best-score trophy and crunchy eat and crash effects. Fully offline.
